blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— Nostalgia. This is what avid Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show fans felt today. Bella Hadid opened the show after years of hiatus and the fantasy bra made its return. Here are some photos from the show: This year’s VSF show happened at Sony Pictures Studios in Los Angeles, California. Around 20 plus models lit up the runway in signature lingerie and wings— a combination that made makes this fashion show one of the most iconic in recent years. Among the veteran models that strut the runway were Adriana Lima, Candice Swanepoel, Ashley Graham, Alessandra Ambrosio, Behati Prinsloo, Gigi […]...
